description_en: Changes the resource group to which a file system instance belongs
description_zh: 修改文件系统实例所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun nas change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id 31a8e40000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmwavnfdf0000 --resource-type filesystem --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the zone.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412111.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
可用区所在的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412111.html查看最新地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The new resource group ID.

You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Management console (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups?)
parameters.help_zh:
新资源组ID。

您可以通过资源管理控制台 (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups?)查看资源组ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

Valid values: filesystem (file system)
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

取值：filesystem（文件系统）
parameters.name: resource_type
